### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>containerd/stargz-snapshotter (github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/estargz)</summary>

### [`v0.19.0`](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/releases/tag/v0.19.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/compare/v0.18.2...v0.19.0)

#### Security Updates

- [CVE-2026-71482](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/security/advisories/GHSA-6q59-3mx3-jpgq)
- [CVE-2026-77395](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/security/advisories/GHSA-6j84-h5gg-w3gr)
  - To mitigate this issue, v0.19.0 requires a configuration change to the CRI setting. Specifically, the --image-service-endpoint=unix:///run/containerd-stargz-grpc/containerd-stargz-grpc.sock flag needs to be specified on kubelet. Refer to `kubelet configuration` section in docs/overview\.md for details.

#### Notable Changes

- estargz: Fix encoder panic in go 1.27 by emitting footer manually ([#​2333](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2333))
- ctr-remote i optimize: GPU: migrate to CDI ([#​2334](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2334))
- fs: add ns query parameter to mirror requests per OCI distribution spec ([#​2363](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2363)), thanks to [@​simonepri](https://redirect.github.com/simonepri)
- fusemanager: Add a dedicated metrics endpoint ([#​2356](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2356)), thanks to [@​mironovgh](https://redirect.github.com/mironovgh)
- estargz: add --estargz-parallelism to control build parallelism ([#​2341](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2341)), thanks to [@​simonepri](https://redirect.github.com/simonepri)
- Reset instead of dropping registry traffic in integration tests ([#​2362](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2362)), thanks to [@​kzys](https://redirect.github.com/kzys)
- Build the k3s node image with make image ([#​2361](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2361)), thanks to [@​kzys](https://redirect.github.com/kzys)
- simplify waiter implementation in fs ([#​2270](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2270)), thanks to [@​wswsmao](https://redirect.github.com/wswsmao)
- estargz: fix panic in GzipDecompressor.ParseFooter on empty Extra field ([#​2256](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2256)), thanks to [@​kylos101](https://redirect.github.com/kylos101)
- go.mod remove excludes that are no longer needed ([#​2254](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2254)), thanks to [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah)
- estargz: deprecate errorutil in favor of native errors.Join ([#​2247](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2247)), thanks to [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah)
- estargz: Build: replace golang.org/x/sync with WaitGroup.Go (go1.25) ([#​2249](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2249)), thanks to [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah)
- modernize some code ([#​2248](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2248)), thanks to [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah)

</details>
